expected.log_message: Pre-activation backup failed; aborting activation so the current world stays untouched.

notes: The backupWorld closure's result gates everything downstream: 'guard ok else { ...; return false }' at lines 677-680 exits before the removeOk block (line 685) ever runs. This is the case that makes the mandatory-backup guarantee actually load-bearing rather than cosmetic -- if a failed backup were ignored, activation would proceed to delete the only copy of the current world with nothing to fall back to.
